notes: Two branches meet at Malik; the rest («فيما قرئ عليه» is a pointer to the reading) is written once: the shared tail
Tawus says he met companions who said «كل شيء بقدر»: they are unnamed transmitters of the saying, last link
Second saying with its own isnad («وسمعت عبد الله بن عمر يقول قال رسول الله») is Tawus from Ibn Umar: rule 11, not written as a route here; needs a ruling
